message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta.**  
The City of Atlanta handles noise complaints through its **Code Enforcement** office and the **Atlanta Police Department**. The city council itself does not take individual complaints, but it can refer you to the appropriate department.

| How to File | Contact Details | Notes |
|-------------|-----------------|-------|
| **Online (311 portal)** | https://311.atlantaga.gov | Use the “Noise Complaint” form. |
| **Phone (non‑emergency)** | 404‑292‑3111 (Atlanta 311) | Call 311 for general city services, including noise complaints. |
| **Email** | code.enforcement@atlantaga.gov | Send details of the complaint (time, location, description). |
| **In‑person** | City Hall, 1000 Peachtree St NE, Atlanta, GA 30308 | Visit the Code Enforcement office. |
| **Police (if immediate action needed)** | 404‑292‑3111 (Atlanta Police) | Call 911 only for emergencies. |

### Quick Steps

1. **Gather Information** – Date, time, location, description of the noise, and any evidence (audio/video, photos).
2. **Choose a Method** – Online, phone, email, or in‑person.
3. **Submit the Complaint** – Provide all details; the city will assign a case number.
4. **Follow Up** – You can track the status via the 311 portal or by calling 404‑292‑3111.

### City Noise Ordinance

The City of Atlanta’s noise ordinance is available here:  
https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/code-enforcement/noise-ordinance

If you’re unsure which department to contact, start with the 311 portal or call 404‑292‑3111. The city council can then direct the complaint to the proper agency if needed.
